review.shows: Offices on record: Michigan House with start and end both 2018-12-31 (marked unsure), a Michigan Senate entry dated 2022-12-31 (unsure), and Michigan Senate from 2023-01-01.
review.problem: The Michigan Senate Democrats' caucus biography (a party caucus page, not a government one) says he served in the Michigan House after the Southfield City Council (elected 2011) and is now in his second Senate term, so his Senate service began with the 2019 term, not 2023, and his House service was a span of years (2015 to 2019 by Wikipedia), not one day.
